d:
Addressing a press conference in New Delhi, actor-activist Prakash Raj criticized the Election Commission over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and alleged irregularities in voter Forms 6, 7, and 8. He challenged Home Minister Amit Shah to substantiate claims of three crore infiltrators, citing official verification data from Telangana and Karnataka. Demanding accountability from Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, Raj announced a nationwide campaign until the SIR process is withdrawn.
Thank you for watching our video!
